recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片幾乎全為細胞、脂肪極少，並可見多處顏色較深藍、呈結節或片狀的細胞聚集散布在較淡的骨髓中；這些深染聚集在高倍下為未成熟紅系前驅細胞群，是 PCM1::JAK2 腫瘤的線索，但低倍本身不具特異性。
features: Bone marrow core with near 100% cellularity and markedly reduced fat
Multiple darker basophilic nodular to sheet-like aggregates of immature cells
Paler intervening areas of mixed hematopoiesis with red cells
Bony trabeculae of normal thickness without osteosclerosis
describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near 100% cellularity and minimal fat. Multiple darker basophilic nodular and sheet-like aggregates of immature-appearing cells are distributed among paler areas of mixed hematopoiesis. Bony trabeculae appear unremarkable. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification; higher power and immunostains (glycophorin, CD34, CD117) are needed to characterize the aggregates. In the context of PCM1::JAK2 fusion, the aggregates correspond to expanded islands of immature erythroid precursors.

ddx.vs: Blast aggregates are CD34/CD117 positive and glycophorin negative on immunohistochemistry.
Lymphoid aggregates are composed of CD20 or CD3 positive lymphocytes and may be paratrabecular or nodular.
CML marrow is hypercellular with granulocytic predominance and small megakaryocytes, and requires BCR::ABL1 rather than erythroid islands.
Tumor nests show cohesive epithelial or other non-hematopoietic morphology with desmoplasia and lineage-specific markers.
